text:
Sam: Quick sync — we need to lock down the design-partner funnel + success criteria for the private beta. proposal: 6 weeks, 8 partners, 3 buckets (power users, integrators, regulated). thoughts?
Anya: sounds fine. can we be explicit about instrumentation? just dashboards + 1 simple weekly survey.
Devin: +1 on 8 partners. curious if we should require a small integration (webhook or SDK) to count them as "active"?
Sam: yes — propose an "integration gate": at least one end-to-end test call + dashboard events for latency, error rate, and token counts.
Priya: for recruitment, i'd like us to prioritize: 1) customers with production-ish traffic, 2) cross-functional exec sponsor, 3) ability to join weekly 30m sessions. that will help signal commitment.
Sam: agreed. recruitment screening draft (short):
```
1) Primary use-case
2) Approx calls/day
3) Can you run a test integration in a sandbox within 2 weeks? (y/n)
4) Data sensitivity (public/internal/regulated)
```
Anya: can we add one prompt-quality anchor question so we can track quality regression baseline? even one prompt set per partner is helpful.
Devin: operational metrics we should collect: p50/p95 latency, token cost per request, error rate, cold-start rate, and prefix cache hit%.
Priya: graduation criteria idea: (a) 4+ weekly sessions completed, (b) integration gate passed, (c) no severe regressions vs baseline (>=95% prompts within tolerance), (d) partner agrees to a short testimonial / case note.
Sam: love that. add a numeric target for "no severe regressions": <=5% prompts flagged as regression by partner review.
Anya: for feedback loops: weekly 30m sync + async M-F Slack channel + short 3-question survey every Friday (ease, reliability, overall value 1-10).
recruiting-bot: added candidate spreadsheet: https://docs.internal/redwood/beta-candidates (please triage) :white_check_mark:
Devin: timeline: recruit 2 weeks, onboarding + integration 2 weeks, active beta 6 weeks, wrap + handoff 1 week. total ~11 weeks. ok?
Priya: sounds realistic. i'll draft outreach language and share templates by EOD.
Sam: action items: Priya outreach template, Anya instrumentation dashboard spec, Devin integration checklist, recruiting-bot keep candidate list updated. want to finalize by Thursday so sales/research can start outreach. :rocket:
Anya: i'll sketch the dashboard (simple grafana panels) and surface the event schema here by tomorrow.
Devin: i'll write the minimal SDK test harness and an example curl flow.
Priya: will post outreach templates and screening rubric in this thread when ready.
Sam: thank you — short sync tomorrow 10am to finalize gating language. :thumbsup:
